supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: measurable extension beyond the lateral margin of the visible ocular orbit

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: marked contrast between dark periocular skin and high-intensity grey/white hair across the muzzle and chin

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thin 2D vertical profile with minimal structural droop

other_distinctive_markers: pronounced white/grey hair growth concentrated on the chin and mandibular region
